taylor_expansion_proof.expansion_derivation: d_FR^2(P, P+eps v) = 4 arccos^2(sum sqrt(P_k(P_k+eps v_k))) = eps^2 sum (v_k^2/P_k) + O(eps^3). JSD(P || P+eps v) = 1/8 eps^2 sum (v_k^2/P_k) + O(eps^3). Limiting ratio = 8.
